title: He Said - She Said
source_credit: VOA Learning English — Let's Learn English Level 2, Lesson 3. Human VOA audio; WorldVoice provides only a selected, bilingual transcript excerpt; read the full conversation on the credited official page. No sentence timings have been verified. WorldVoice is not affiliated with VOA.

dialogue.speaker: Kelly
dialogue.text: You two are late -- exactly 43 minutes late! What happened?
dialogue.translation_ar: أنتما متأخران، بالتحديد 43 دقيقة! ماذا حدث؟

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.text: He had to get his "special" coffee -- SPECIAL coffee!
dialogue.translation_ar: كان لا بد له من الحصول على قهوته «الخاصة»... قهوة خاصة جدًا!

dialogue.speaker: Pete
dialogue.text: She had to feed her birds -- HER birds!
dialogue.translation_ar: كان عليها أن تطعم طيورها... طيورها هي!

dialogue.speaker: Kelly
dialogue.text: Okay, I can see already that you need my help. You can’t both talk at the same time. You have to take turns. Alright, Anna, you go first.
dialogue.translation_ar: حسنًا، أرى أنكما بحاجة إلى مساعدتي. لا يمكنكما التحدث في الوقت نفسه، عليكما التناوب. آنا، ابدئي أنت.

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.text: Sure. Kelly, see, Pete and I live in the same building. So, we decided to meet at 8:00 a.m. - 8:00 a.m. to come to work together. I had waited 15 minutes when Pete arrived!
dialogue.translation_ar: بالتأكيد. أنا وبيت نسكن في المبنى نفسه، فاتفقنا أن نلتقي الثامنة صباحًا لنذهب إلى العمل معًا. كنت قد انتظرت خمس عشرة دقيقة حين وصل بيت.

dialogue.speaker: Kelly
dialogue.text: Hum. I didn’t get that message.
